rule.name: strict_same_requirement_effective_duration_reduction
rule.dominance_relation: remove a non-idle local option only when another option has the exact same integer requirement tuple and a strictly shorter max(idle_duration, duration)
rule.equal_duration_rule: retain every option tied at the minimum effective duration
rule.retained_order: preserve original catalogue order and map every returned lane tuple monotonically back to original catalogue indices
rule.budget: K counts only the reduced v4 idle seed, homogeneous seeds, and lazy candidate construction or feasibility attempts
rule.unchanged: v4 queue-local ordering among retained options, prefix tree, feasibility, support objective, suffix bound, strict pruning, duration tie, and original raw-index tie order
rule.support_argument: replacement preserves service and feasibility and cannot increase frame duration, so reduced and original families have the same maximum one-frame support for every queue
rule.excluded_claim: no completion-offset, FIFO-flow, mean-flow, or P90 dominance is claimed
rule.full_search_cap: frozen two-lane cap is 9 reduced seeds plus 9 one-lane and 81 two-lane ordered attempts = 99

protocol.stopping_rule: execute the fixed 5,003-state screen once; invalid execution precedes all scientific decisions; any pointwise or population regression gives REGRESSION_STOP; absent both strict-gain conditions gives NO_GAIN_STOP, except unchanged actions with only certificate or work gain give EFFICIENCY_ONLY_STOP; any exact previously tested quotient pair gives KNOWN_QUOTIENT_ACTION_STOP; only otherwise-new changed actions advance
